{{Quote|The starport master is more interested in his new ''tunic''&mdash;which you will notice is made of ''koolach silk''.|[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] regarding [[Koh'shak]]'s [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]]|<ref name="Rogue Squadron 11">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 11|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 11]]</ref>}}
'''Koolach silk''' was a luxury cloth [[Winter Celchu]] used to bribe the [[Kala'uun Starport]] master as part of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron's]] attempt at capturing [[Firith Olan]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|224|koolach silk}}</ref> The silk originated from the [[Koolach system/Legends|Koolach system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Koolach silk|system=[[Koolach system/Legends|Koolach system]]|legends=1}}</ref>
